extracted.name: 🥖 Super Soft Filipino Pandesal
extracted.description: 🥖 Super Soft & Fluffy Pandesal Our Super Soft & Fluffy Pandesal is Minda’s Kitchen’s take on the classic Filipino bread roll — golden on the outside, light and airy on the inside, and coated with just the right amount of fine breadcrumbs for that nostalgic crunch. Each roll is freshly baked daily to achieve a pillowy texture that melts in your mouth with every bite. Enjoy it warm with butter, cheese, jam, or a cup of coffee for the perfect breakfast or afternoon snack. Whether you’re craving a comforting bite of home or introducing Filipino flavors to your friends, this pandesal delivers the perfect balance of soft sweetness and bakery-fresh aroma that everyone will love
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp milk powder or 1 tbsp condensed milk for richer flavor (optional)
instruction_lines: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast. Stir lightly and let sit for 5–10 minutes until foamy. Add melted butter and egg to the yeast mixture. Whisk gently until smooth.

In a large bowl, combine flour and salt. Gradually pour in the wet mixture. Mix with a spatula or stand mixer until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms. (If using hands, grease your palms lightly with oil.) Knead for 10–12 minutes (or 7–8 minutes in mixer) until smooth and elastic. Dough should be soft but not overly sticky.

Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with a towel or plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Punch down the dough. Divide into 24 small balls. Roll each into oval or round shape. Coat each piece with bread crumbs.

Place on a parchment-lined baking tray, spaced apart. Cover and let rise again for 30–45 minutes until puffy. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Bake for 15–18 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool slightly, then enjoy warm with butter, cheese, or your favorite spread.
